nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A box speaker sits above the fire door, the kind that used to carry the bell. It is still on.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Behind the wall a class is talking all at once, and then stops, as if someone had walked in.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: That is C's lot. They do that.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The speaker clicks twice and goes quiet.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A cleaning trolley is parked across the cupboard, wheels turned in.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A mop, a bucket half full, a bottle of something yellow. The cupboard behind it holds exercise books by the look of the spines.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Leave the bucket. It has been there since Monday.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You leave the trolley where it is. It is in the way of nothing except a cupboard.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You stop at the railing. From up here the yard is a different colour than it is from inside.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Two hoops, a shed, the concrete. Nothing happens in it for a while.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The period goes on without you. That is not unpleasant.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You stood at the walkway railing during the free period and watched the yard.
